items.title: Joe Wilder Part 2 interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 12, 1998
items.q: since the great Joe Smith blew his heavenly sounds in Fletcher Henderson’s band

ctx.x: — and I just wanted to — I could read anything and you wouldn’t know it. It says, “Joe Wilder is blessed with impeccable taste, penetrating intelligence and the most beautiful horn tone since the great Joe Smith blew his heavenly sounds in Fletcher Henderson’s band.”
